name: luna-agent-bridge
description: Opt-in Windows bridge for users who explicitly need persistent external Luna tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Opt-in Windows bridge for persistent tasks.
interface.longDescription: A non-official, opt-in Windows bridge for users who explicitly need cross-session task persistence. It is separate from Codex native subagents and does not start or install a broker automatically.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Luna Agent Bridge only when I explicitly request the external persistent bridge.
